# SWAIRAX

> SWAIRAX is an Africa-first technology company based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. We deliver AI, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Big Data Analytics, Software Engineering, and Cloud & DevOps solutions — built for African realities and ready for the world.

SWAIRAX builds production-grade software, data, and AI systems for businesses of all sizes, and ships its own products. We design for local realities — mobile money, local languages, and on-the-ground infrastructure.

- Founded in and operating from: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
- Contact: info@swairax.com · +255 684 475 390
- Website: https://swairax.com

## Services
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://swairax.com/services/ai): Custom models, LLMs, computer vision, and ML systems.
- [Data Science & Analytics](https://swairax.com/services/data-science): Analytics, dashboards, and decision intelligence.
- [Cybersecurity](https://swairax.com/services/cybersecurity): Security assessments, hardening, and monitoring.
- [Big Data Engineering](https://swairax.com/services/big-data): Pipelines, warehousing, and large-scale processing.
- [Software Engineering](https://swairax.com/services/software): Web and mobile apps, MVPs to production platforms.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://swairax.com/services/cloud-devops): Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and reliability engineering.

## Products
- [TanzaBuild](https://swairax.com/products#tanzabuild): Tanzania's construction services platform — connect with contractors, source materials, and manage your build.
- [Florré](https://swairax.com/products#florre): Luxury salon booking and beauty discovery app for Tanzania.
